name: FlowPilot - Idempotent Lead Intake and Processing

parameters.query:
UPDATE leads
SET draft_subject = $1, draft_body = $2, draft_status = $3
WHERE id = $4
RETURNING id, draft_subject, draft_body, draft_status;

WITH issued AS (
  UPDATE leads
  SET approval_token = gen_random_uuid(),
      approval_expires_at = NOW() + INTERVAL '48 hours',
      approval_decided_at = NULL,
      initial_response_sent_at = NULL
  WHERE id = $1
    AND draft_status = 'pending_approval'
    AND NULLIF(BTRIM(draft_subject), '') IS NOT NULL
    AND NULLIF(BTRIM(draft_body), '') IS NOT NULL
  RETURNING id, approval_token, approval_expires_at
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM issued) AS issued,
  (SELECT id FROM issued) AS id,
  (SELECT approval_token::text FROM issued) AS approval_token,
  (SELECT approval_expires_at FROM issued) AS approval_expires_at;

parameters.query:
WITH candidate AS (
  SELECT
    $1::text AS idempotency_key,
    encode(sha256(convert_to($2::text, 'UTF8')), 'hex') AS request_fingerprint,
    gen_random_uuid() AS attempted_claim_token
), claimed AS (
  INSERT INTO flowpilot_idempotency (
    idempotency_key,
    request_fingerprint,
    status,
    claim_token,
    workflow_stage,
    stage_updated_at
  )
  SELECT
    idempotency_key,
    request_fingerprint,
    'processing',
    attempted_claim_token,
    'claimed',
    NOW()
  FROM candidate
  ON CONFLICT (idempotency_key) DO UPDATE
    SET updated_at = flowpilot_idempotency.updated_at
  RETURNING
    flowpilot_idempotency.request_fingerprint,
    flowpilot_idempotency.status,
    flowpilot_idempotency.claim_token,
    flowpilot_idempotency.response_payload,
    flowpilot_idempotency.claim_token = (SELECT attempted_claim_token FROM candidate) AS is_owner
)
SELECT
  CASE
    WHEN claimed.request_fingerprint <> candidate.request_fingerprint THEN 'conflict'
    WHEN claimed.is_owner THEN 'owner'
    WHEN claimed.status = 'completed' THEN 'completed'
    WHEN claimed.status = 'processing' THEN 'in_progress'
    WHEN claimed.status = 'recovery_required' THEN 'recovery_required'
    ELSE 'failed'
  END AS outcome,
  claimed.request_fingerprint,
  claimed.claim_token::text AS claim_token,
  CASE WHEN claimed.status = 'completed' THEN claimed.response_payload ELSE NULL END AS response_payload
FROM claimed
CROSS JOIN candidate;

WITH finalized AS (
  UPDATE flowpilot_idempotency
  SET status = 'completed',
      completed_at = NOW(),
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE idempotency_key = $1
    AND request_fingerprint = $2
    AND claim_token = $3::uuid
    AND status = 'processing'
    AND workflow_stage = 'business_complete'
    AND (CASE
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(response_payload) = 'object' THEN
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(response_payload)) = 4
      AND response_payload ?& ARRAY['success', 'route', 'message', 'analysis']::text[]
      AND (response_payload->'success') = 'true'::jsonb
      AND jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'route') = 'string'
      AND response_payload->>'route' IN ('high', 'medium', 'low')
      AND jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'message') = 'string'
      AND CASE
        WHEN jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'analysis') = 'object' THEN
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(response_payload->'analysis')) = 5
          AND (response_payload->'analysis') ?& ARRAY['category', 'priority', 'lead_score', 'short_summary', 'recommended_action']::text[]
          AND jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'analysis'->'category') = 'string'
          AND jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'analysis'->'priority') = 'string'
          AND response_payload->'analysis'->>'priority' IN ('high', 'medium', 'low')
          AND response_payload->>'route' = response_payload->'analysis'->>'priority'
          AND jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'analysis'->'short_summary') = 'string'
          AND jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'analysis'->'recommended_action') = 'string'
          AND CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof(response_payload->'analysis'->'lead_score') = 'number'
              AND response_payload->'analysis'->>'lead_score' ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,2})$'
            THEN (response_payload->'analysis'->>'lead_score')::integer BETWEEN 0 AND 100
            ELSE FALSE
          END
        ELSE FALSE
      END
    ELSE FALSE
  END)
  RETURNING status
)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM finalized) AS idempotency_completed;

parameters.query:
WITH classified AS (
  UPDATE flowpilot_idempotency
  SET status = CASE workflow_stage
        WHEN 'claimed' THEN 'failed'
        WHEN 'business_started' THEN 'recovery_required'
      END,
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE idempotency_key = $1
    AND request_fingerprint = $2
    AND claim_token = $3::uuid
    AND status = 'processing'
    AND workflow_stage IN ('claimed', 'business_started')
  RETURNING status
)
SELECT
  EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM classified) AS idempotency_classified,
  (SELECT status FROM classified) AS idempotency_status;

parameters.query:
WITH advanced AS (
  UPDATE flowpilot_idempotency
  SET workflow_stage = 'business_started',
      stage_updated_at = NOW(),
      updated_at = NOW()
  WHERE idempotency_key = $1
    AND request_fingerprint = $2
    AND claim_token = $3::uuid
    AND status = 'processing'
    AND workflow_stage = 'claimed'
  RETURNING workflow_stage
)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM advanced) AS business_started;

parameters.query:
WITH incoming AS (
  SELECT $4::jsonb AS response_payload
), recorded AS (
  UPDATE flowpilot_idempotency
  SET workflow_stage = 'business_complete',
      stage_updated_at = NOW(),
      response_payload = incoming.response_payload,
      updated_at = NOW()
  FROM incoming
  WHERE idempotency_key = $1
    AND request_fingerprint = $2
    AND claim_token = $3::uuid
    AND status = 'processing'
    AND workflow_stage = 'business_started'
    AND (CASE
    WHEN jsonb_typeof(incoming.response_payload) = 'object' THEN
      (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(incoming.response_payload)) = 4
      AND incoming.response_payload ?& ARRAY['success', 'route', 'message', 'analysis']::text[]
      AND (incoming.response_payload->'success') = 'true'::jsonb
      AND jsonb_typeof(incoming.response_payload->'route') = 'string'
      AND incoming.response_payload->>'route' IN ('high', 'medium', 'low')
      AND jsonb_typeof(incoming.response_payload->'message') = 'string'
      AND CASE
        WHEN jsonb_typeof(incoming.response_payload->'analysis') = 'object' THEN
          (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM jsonb_object_keys(incoming.response_payload->'analysis')) = 5
          AND (incoming.response_payload->'analysis') ?& ARRAY['category', 'priority', 'lead_score', 'short_summary', 'recommended_action']::text[]
          AND jsonb_typeof(incoming.response_payload->'analysis'->'category') = 'string'
          AND jsonb_typeof(incoming.response_payload->'analysis'->'priority') = 'string'
          AND incoming.response_payload->'analysis'->>'priority' IN ('high', 'medium', 'low')
          AND incoming.response_payload->>'route' = incoming.response_payload->'analysis'->>'priority'
          AND jsonb_typeof(incoming.response_payload->'analysis'->'short_summary') = 'string'
          AND jsonb_typeof(incoming.response_payload->'analysis'->'recommended_action') = 'string'
          AND CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof(incoming.response_payload->'analysis'->'lead_score') = 'number'
              AND incoming.response_payload->'analysis'->>'lead_score' ~ '^(0|[1-9][0-9]{0,2})$'
            THEN (incoming.response_payload->'analysis'->>'lead_score')::integer BETWEEN 0 AND 100
            ELSE FALSE
          END
        ELSE FALSE
      END
    ELSE FALSE
  END)
  RETURNING workflow_stage
)
SELECT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM recorded) AS business_complete;
